name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.letterProj_mem_constantsModE
summary: letterProj(x) ∈ locLetterPart; its Galois differences keep the standard exponents and, at E, are Galois differences of invariant form values of x.

steps.claim: letterProj(L, i)(x) ∈ locLetterPart(L, l, i) (letterProj_mem_of_valueFieldPoints with H.1); for g = (0, γ), g·y − y has the standard exponents of level l (smul_sub_mem_withExponents) and at a = 0 its value under μ of type u is γ·μ'(x) − μ'(x) with μ' = μ ∘ letterProj an invariant form (comp_letterProj_mem_forms), in hodgeFil(A) by H.2.
steps.lean:
(fun y ↦ ⟨y, fun ⟨_, γ, rfl⟩ ↦
  mem_withExponents_of_mem_hodgeFil (smul_sub_mem_withExponents y.2 _) (·.rec (fun _ _ _ _ m ↦ by
  simpa [shiftedStd, stdExponent, hl, ↓valueAt_smul_sub y.1.1 m.1] using!
    H.2 _ (comp_letterProj_mem_forms m.1) γ) (by simp))⟩) (letterProj_mem_of_valueFieldPoints H.1)
